# Aurora-Twilight

Aurora-Twilight ships a light and a dark colour scheme, with Quicksand set for headings and Cabin for body text. Headings, bold text and italic text each get their own colour, and interface elements are given rounded corners.

![Aurora-Twilight screenshot](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/quinta0/Aurora-Twilight/HEAD/image-small.png)

```cue
theme: {
    name:   "Aurora-Twilight"
    author: "quinta0"
    repo:   "quinta0/Aurora-Twilight"
    slug:   "aurora-twilight"

    html_url:       "https://community.obsidian.md/themes/aurora-twilight"
    github_url:     "https://github.com/quinta0/Aurora-Twilight"
    screenshot_url: "https://raw.githubusercontent.com/quinta0/Aurora-Twilight/HEAD/image-small.png"

    modes: ["dark", "light"]
    about: "Apply a light and dark color scheme for Obsidian with Quicksand headings and Cabin body fonts. Give headings, bold and italic text distinctive colors and add rounded corners to UI elements for a softer, cohesive look."
}
```
